parsed_findings.summary: Located CVE-2020-21818: heap-buffer-overflow in htmlescape() reached from output_TEXT in dwg2SVG.

findings.source: TEXT entity string in a crafted DWG, emitted by dwg2SVG
findings.sink: strcat of multi-byte HTML entity into an under-sized malloc buffer
findings.data_flow: text->text_value -> output_TEXT (dwg2SVG.c:135) -> htmlescape -> strcat loop overruns malloc(strlen+10)
findings.safety_condition: buffer must have room for the longest expansion (" etc.) at every step
findings.triggering_input: DWG with a TEXT entity full of characters that expand to 5-6 byte entities
findings.explanation: malloc(strlen(src)+10) with a loose off>=len-8 guard and off-by-one while(*s++); confirmed via ASan on a crafted DWG.

notes: illustrative fixture — not a real Codex run
